answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in willow, checked in ledge, and saffron reveals each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 12 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 3237 identities would post 4194 proofs and burn roughly 69 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
